question: Why did Intel's gross margin fall in 2024?
summary: Intel's gross margin fell in FY2024: 40.0% -> 32.7% (-7.4 pts). The evidence is consistent with these drivers: (1) restructuring and impairment charges increased; (2) depreciation from heavy capital spending rose as a share of revenue; (3) revenue fell, so fixed manufacturing costs were spread over fewer sales (under-absorption).
supported: Revenue fell, so fixed manufacturing costs were spread over fewer sales (under-absorption)
Depreciation from heavy capital spending rose as a share of revenue

H1: Revenue fell, so fixed manufacturing costs were spread over fewer sales (under-absorption)
H2: Depreciation from heavy capital spending rose as a share of revenue

reference: Gross margin fell to 32.7% on large restructuring/impairment and accelerated-depreciation charges (Intel 7 assets), higher inventory reserves and higher unit costs from new process nodes (Intel 2024 10-K, MD&A).
